ability_description_2: The first time each turn that Lady Jaye is targeted for an attack by a Squad figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, Lady Jaye cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attacks this turn. ZIPLINE: TACTICAL MOVE (Permanent Glyph) Once per turn, when a Small or Medium figure ends its movement on a Zipline Glyph while moving normally, you may choose another Zipline Glyph within 6 spaces of that Zipline Glyph. Place that figure on a space within 1 of and on the same level as that Glyph. A figure that is engaged when it starts to zipline will take any leaving engagement attacks. Figures may move over a Zipline Glyph without stopping.

ability_description_1: All friendly figures with a range of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 spaces to their Range number. Vydar’s Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.
ability_description_2: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie Dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

ability_description_1: When a Squad figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Loviatäk the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Brutality Aura may only be used once per turn.
ability_description_2: When attacking with Loviatäk, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
ability_description_3: If you control Loviatäk and another Unique Kyrie Hero who follows Utgar, figures you control who follow Utgar increase their Move Value by 1.
ability_description_4: When counting spaces for Loviatäk's movement, ignore elevations. Loviatäk may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Loviatäk starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: If a Lurking Hive Soldier is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Lurking Hive Soldier. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.
ability_description_2: A Lurking Hive Soldier is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

ability_description_1: At the start of the game, choose a Human Champion you control. While that champion is in play, MacDirk Warriors roll one additional attack die for each wound marker on the chosen hero. There can be only one Chosen Human Champion for all the MacDirk Warriors you control. MacDirk Warriors cannot attack their Chosen Human Champion.
ability_description_2: Before taking a turn with the MacDirk Warriors, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.

set_wave: Valda's Vow: Fury of the Verdant Pact
ability_description_1: Range Special. Attack 4. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Maeve Sunderstone, you may move her up to 3 spaces. Then move Maeve up to 5 spaces in a straight line, passing through all figures and taking no leaving engagement attacks. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through. Each figure rolls defense dice separately in the order moved through. Defending figures never have height advantage against this attack.
ability_description_2: After Maeve makes a normal attack against a single-space figure, if the defending figure is still adjacent, you may move that figure 1 space. Figures moved this way do not take leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: Range 5. Attack 0 + Special. Explosion 1. Add 2 automatic skulls to the attack roll. Major Bludd is not affected by his own Bludd's Blaster Special Attack. Bludd can use this attack only once per round.

set_wave: Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
ability_description_1: Range 7 Attack 2 Major Q10 may use this special attack 4 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.
ability_description_2: Range 4 Attack 4 Major Q10 may use this special attack 2 times in the same turn. Q10 may target the same figure or a different figure with each attack.

ability_description_1: Range Special. Attack Special. When using Full Barrage Special Attack, Major Q11 may attack up to 3 times. Each attack must target a different figure and must use a different Range and Attack Value pair from the list below (in any order).: * Range 7, Attack 2. * Range 5, Attack 3. * Range 3, Attack 4. Major Q11 cannot target the same figure more than once per turn with Full Barrage Special Attack.
ability_description_2: When Major Q11 attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, you may choose one Small, Medium or Large figure that is adjacent to the defending figure. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Major Q11's attack, the chosen figure receives one wound.

ability_description_1: Range 6. Attack 1, 2 or 3. Major Q9 starts each turn with 9 attack dice. Choose any figure within range and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Major Q9 may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until he has rolled all 9 attack dice. Major Q9 may target the same or different figures with each attack.

All small, medium or large opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to Major X17 may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
ability_description_2: When rollling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, Major X17 adds 4 dice.

ability_description_1: After revealing an Order Marker on Marachott, Mind Whisperer, before taking Marachott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.
ability_description_2: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Marachott always adds 2 automatic skulls to whatever is rolled.
ability_description_3: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and taking a turn with Marachott, you may choose a Unique Hero within 2 spaces of Marachott. Roll the 20-sided die, adding 3 to the roll if you control that Hero. If you roll a 16 or higher, take temporary control of that Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. After taking that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. Any Order Markers that were on the chosen figure's Army Card stay on that card.

ability_description_1: Each time Marcu Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Marcu Esenwein cannot Life Drain Destructible Objects.
ability_description_2: After revealing an order marker on this card, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, choose an opponent. That opponent will now control Marcu Esenwein for the remainder of your turn, but will not be able to view any unrevealed order markers on his card. At the end of that turn, control of Marcu returns to you. All order markers and figures that were on Marcu’s Army Card will stay on his Army Card.
ability_description_3: When counting spaces for Marcu Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Marcu Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Marcu Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: All Soldiers you control move one additional space.
ability_description_2: All friendly Soldiers adjacent to Marcus Decimus Gallus receive an additional attack die.

ability_description_1: When a Mariedian Resistance figure attacks, it adds 1 to its Attack Value for each other Mariedian that attacked the targeted figure this Player Turn.
ability_description_2: When a Mariedian Resistance figure defends, it adds 1 to its Defense Value for each other time a friendly Soldier has defended this Player Turn.

ability_description_1: Before moving, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-3, add 1 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 4-6, add 3 to the move value of this card. If you roll a 7-20, add 7 to the move value of this card.
ability_description_2: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to any Marrden Hounds you control. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Soulborgs and Wulsinu are not affected by the Marro Plague.

set_wave: Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
ability_description_1: Before taking a turn with Marrden Nagrubs, you may first take a turn with any Hivelord you control. Before moving the chosen Hivelord, you may destroy one adjacent Marrden Nagrub you control. If you destroy a Marrden Nagrub with Hivelord Life Bonding, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen Hivelord's Army Card.
ability_description_2: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Marrden Nagrubs may double their Height.

ability_description_1: When a Marro Divider you control receives one or more wounds from a Normal or Special Attack by an opponent's figure, you may roll the 20-sided die before removing that figure. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds that figure just received and, if possible, place one of your previously destroyed Marro Dividers on a same-level space adjacent to the defending Marro Divider.
ability_description_2: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Marro Dividers with its Marro Rebirth special power.

ability_description_1: Before moving Marro Drones, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-12, you may move and attack with up to 3 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 13-16, you may move and attack with up to 6 Marro Drones you control. If you roll 17-20, you may move and attack with up to 9 Marro Drones you control.

set_wave: Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
ability_description_1: When a Marro Drudge is on a swamp water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.
ability_description_2: If a Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If a Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

set_wave: Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
ability_description_1: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you may take a turn with any small or medium common Marro Squad you control before taking a turn with Marro Hive. Any figure that is taking a turn must be within 12 clear sight spaces of Marro Hive, prior to its movement.
ability_description_2: After taking a turn with Marro Hive, you may roll the 20-sided die. if you roll a 13 or higher, you may place any previously destroyed common Marro Squad figure from your army on an empty space adjacent to Marro Hive.

set_wave: Master Set 2: Swarm of the Morrow
ability_description_1: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, you must destroy a Marro Stinger you control and you cannot attack this turn. If you roll a 5-9, add 0 to the attack value of this card. If you roll a 10 or higher, add 1 to the attack value of this card.

set_wave: Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie
ability_description_1: Instead of attacking with all of the Marro Warriors, one at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each Marro Warrior in play. If you roll a 15 or higher, place a previously destroyed Marro Warrior on a same-level space adjacent to that Marro Warrior. Any Marro Warrior on a water space needs a 10 or higher to Water Clone. You may only Water Clone after you move.

After attacking an opponent's Unique Hero with this Master of the Hunt's normal attack, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, place 1 additional wound Marker on the defending figure's Army Card.
ability_description_2: After moving and before attacking with this Master of the Hunt, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, add 3 to this Master of the Hunt's Range value for the duration of its turn.

ability_description_1: All Monk squad figures you control may leap an additional 13 levels up or down when using their Stealth Leap special power. All Monks you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Master Woo add 1 to their attack dice and 1 to their defense dice.
ability_description_2: Master Woo may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack seperately.
ability_description_3: Instead of his normal move, Master Woo may use Stealth Leap 25. Stealth Leap 25 has a move of 3. When counting spaces for Stealth Leap 25, ignore elevations. Master Woo may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Master Woo may not leap more than 25 levels up or down in a single leap. If Master Woo is engaged when he starts his Stealth Leap, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: After moving and before attacking, choose any small or medium figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Me-Burq-Sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by Me-Burq-Sa this turn.
When a Mezzodemon Warmonger attacks a Common figure, add 1 to its attack value.
ability_description_2: At the start of the game, place 1 copper Exoskeleton marker on a Mezzodemon Warmongers Army Card for each Mezzodemon Warmonger figure in your Army. After a Mezzodemon Warmonger rolls defense dice against a normal attack, you may remove 1 Exoskeleton marker from its Army Card to ignore all wounds inflicted by that attack.

ability_description_1: When a Microcorp Agent receives one or more wounds, before removing that agent, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore any wounds.
ability_description_2: Microcorp Agents do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space. Add 2 to a Microcorp Agent's defense while he is on a water space.
ability_description_3: When a Microcorp Agent is attacking with a height advantage, he rolls an additional attack die.

ability_description_1: Once per turn, after attacking with Mielki the Kyrie Warrior, she may make one additional normal attack.
ability_description_2: When Mielki destroys a figure with a normal attack, you may choose a Small or Medium friendly figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Mielki. Remove a Wound Marker from the chosen figure. Mielki cannot heal herself with Spear of Sankari, and it cannot be used when destroying a destructible object.
ability_description_3: When counting spaces for Mielki's movement, ignore elevations. Mielki may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Mielki starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: When attacking with Migol Ironwill each skull rolled counts as one additional hit.
ability_description_2: When rolling defense dice, if Migol Ironwill rolls at least one shield, the most wounds Migol Ironwill can take for this attack is one.
ability_description_3: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Migol Ironwill may double his Height.

ability_description_1: If Mika Connour starts her turn unengaged and on a shadow space, add 3 to her attack this turn.
ability_description_2: If Mika Connour starts her turn on a shadow space, instead of moving normally, you may place her on any other empty shadow space within 8 spaces of her current location. If Mika Connour is engaged when she starts her Shadow Dance, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_description_3: Mika Connour starts each game with up to 2 shadow tiles on her Army Card (included in expansion pack). If Mika Connour ends her turn on an empty land space, you may place a shadow tile from her Army Card onto the space she occupies if the shadow tile fits normally onto that space.

set_wave: Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie
ability_description_1: Range Special. Attack 4. Choose 8 spaces in a straight line from Mimring. All figures on those spaces who are in line of sight are affected by Mimring's Fire Line Special Attack. Roll 4 attack dice once for all affected figures. Affected figures roll defense dice separately.
ability_description_2: When counting spaces for Mimring's movement, ignore elevations. Mimring may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Mimring starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: Range 3 Attack 3. This Mind Flayer Mastermind does not need clear line of sight to attack with Psionic Blast Special Attack. If a figure recieves 1 or more wounds from Psionic Blast Special Attack, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from that figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common card for that figure).
ability_description_2: When revealing an order marker on this Mind Flayer Mastermind, after taking this Mind Flayer Mastermind's turn, you may choose any Unique Hero figure within 4 clear sight spaces of this Mind Flayer Mastermind. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, take temporary control of the chosen Hero and immediately take a turn with that Hero. At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to its previous owner. All order markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card. Enslave does not affect Mindflayers.

ability_description_1: Range 6. Attack 2. This figure may attack up to 4 times with Cluster Cannon Special Attack.
ability_description_2: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the X Order Marker on Mini Tank Armadillo. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.
ability_description_3: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

ability_description_1: Instead of taking a turn with the Minions of Utgar, you may take a turn with any Kyrie Warrior you control who follows Utgar.
ability_description_2: When attacking with Minions of Utgar all skulls rolled count for one additional hit. (ie: 2 skulls rolled inflicts 4 wounds)
ability_description_3: When counting spaces for Minion of Utgar's movement, ignore elevations. Minions of Utgar may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Minions of Utgar starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: Each time this figure destroys a figure, you may remove a Wound Marker from this Army Card. This figure cannot Life Drain destructible objects.
ability_description_2: When Misaerx the Kyrie Warrior is destroyed, place this figure on the Army Card of a Unique Warrior that follows Revna. That Hero now has Life Drain.
ability_description_3: When counting spaces for Misaerx's movement, ignore elevations. Misaerx may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Misaerx starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

set_wave: Wave D1: Champions of Forgotten Realms
ability_description_1: If at least one order marker is on Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may add 3 to your initiative roll.
ability_description_2: After moving and before attacking with Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces that is engaged with any other figure you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
ability_description_3: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Mogrimm Forgehammer always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

ability_description_1: If a Mohican Rive Tribesman is engaged, add 1 to his attack dice and 2 to his defense dice.
ability_description_2: After taking a turn with the Mohican River Tribe, if at least two Mohican River Tribesmen you control are engaged, you may immediately take a turn with one Unique Tribesman Hero you control.
ability_description_3: If a Mohican River Tribesman is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Mochican River Tribesman. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 19 or higher, ignore any wounds the Mohican River Tribesman just received.

ability_description_1: Begin the game with three 1-hex lava field tiles and one 1-hex molten lava tile for every Squad of Molten Crustaceans in your Army. After a Molten Crustacean you control is destroyed by a normal attack or leaving engagement attack, you must roll the 20-sided die and place one of these tiles onto the space the figure occupied, if the tile fits normally on that space. If you roll a 19 or higher place a molten lava tile. Otherwise place a lava field tile.
ability_description_2: Molten Crustaceans are not affected by lava field or molten lava spaces, and do not have to stop their movement on molten lava spaces.
ability_description_3: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Molten Crustaceans may double their Height.

ability_description_1: Range 4 Special Attack 4: Choose a figure to attack, you may also choose 4 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces that are within line of sight of Moltenclaw are affected by Burning Breath Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately, Moltenclaw is not affected by Burning Breath Special Attack. See Mimring for more details.
ability_description_2: Moltenclaw never rolls for molten lava damage and lava field damage, and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.
ability_description_3: When counting spaces for Moltenclaw's movement, ignore elevations. Moltenclaw may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Moltenclaw starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks

ability_description_1: Moriko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_description_2: Range 1. Attack 1, 2 or 3 Moriko starts each turn with 6 attack dice. Choose any adjacent figure and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Moriko may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until she has rolled all 6 attack dice. Moriko may target the same or different figures with each attack.

set_wave: Nastra's Nightmare: Dr. Torvik Morinstein & His Masterpiece
ability_description_1: Morinstein's Masterpiece does not start the game on the battlefield. He must be created by Dr. Torvik Morinstein.
ability_description_2: After taking a turn with a Scientist or Wizard Hero you control, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or higher, immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. If you roll a 1–3, you must choose another player to immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. After Morinstein's Masterpiece takes a turn with Unbelievable Rage, you cannot take another turn during that Player Turn.
ability_description_3: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Morinstein's Masterpiece always adds 1 automatic shield.

ability_description_1: Start the game with 3 brown(gold) Negation Markers on this card. At the end of the turn, if you have at least 1 Negation Marker on this card, you may choose any opponent's unique figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Morsbane. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16-19, place a Negation Marker on the chosen figure's Army Card. All of that figure's special powers are negated for the entire game. If you roll a 20, destroy the chosen figure.

When any Nakita Agent you control, or any figure you control that is adjacent to any Nakita agent you control, is targeted for a normal attack from a non-adjacent opponent, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, all Nakita Agents you control, and all figures you control that are adjacent to those Nakita Agents, no longer have any visible hit zones for the duration of the targeting figure’s turn.
ability_description_2: If an opponent’s small or medium figure moves adjacent to a Nakita Agent, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent’s figure receives a wound. Figures may only be targeted as they move into engagement with a Nakita Agent.
ability_description_3: Before taking a turn with Nakita Agents, you may move 3 Gorillinators you control up to 7 spaces each.

set_wave: Master Set 1: Rise of the Valkyrie
ability_description_1: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Ne-gok-sa. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on this card. If Ne-Gok-Sa is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.
After taking a turn with a Necrotech Geistfire, if that Geistfire attacked a non-adjacent figure, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-5, that Geistfire receives one wound.
Range 1. Attack 4. If a Necrotech Ghastblade attacks with Wild Spin Special Attack, it must attack all adjacent figures, even ones you are not engaged with. Roll each attack separately.
Small and Medium figures engaged with a Necrotech Ghoulgrip cannot move or be moved by any special power or glyph.
ability_description_2: A Necrotech Ghoulgrip adds 1 to its Defense Value when attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure.

ability_description_1: Before taking a turn with Necrotech Reavers, you may first take a turn with an Eisenek Hero you control. If that Hero is Unique, you may only activate 1 Necrotech Reaver.
ability_description_2: At the start of the round, before placing Order Markers, you may replace 1 Necrotech Reaver you control with 1 of your destroyed Common Medium Eisenek Heroes.

ability_description_1: After moving and before attacking with the Necrotech Wraithriders, one at a time, each Wraithrider may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose base is no more than 11 levels above that Wraithrider's level or 6 levels below that Wraithrider's level. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to that Wraithrider. Figures moved by Chain Grab do not take leaving engagement attacks. A figure can only be moved by Chain Grab once each turn.
ability_description_2: A Necrotech Wraithrider cannot move onto a space more than 2 levels above its level.

ability_description_1: Nerak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_description_2: All Orc figures you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Nerak add 1 to their defense dice. Nerak's Orc Defensive Aura does not affect Nerak.
ability_description_3: Add 1 to Nerak's attack and defense while on a snow space.

ability_description_1: Range 5. Attack 4. When Nilfheim attacks with his Ice Shard Breath Special Attack, he may attack 2 additional times. He cannot attack the same figure more than once.
ability_description_2: When counting spaces for Nilfheim's movement, ignore elevations. Nilfheim may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Nilfheim starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: If a Ninja of the Northern Wind is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to disappear. If you roll 1-11, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 12 or higher, that Ninja of the Northern Wind takes no damage and instead may move up to 4 spaces. Ninjas of the Northern Wind can disappear only if they end their disappearing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.
ability_description_2: Ninjas of the Northern Wind can move through all figures.
ability_description_3: Ninjas of the Northern Wind are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

set_wave: Secrets of the Citadel: Battle for Blackscar
ability_description_1: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Nishi Souta, you may take a turn with another Samurai Hero you control.
ability_description_2: After revealing an Order Marker on and taking a turn with Souta, if he is within 5 clear sight spaces of an enemy figure, you may take a turn with another Lawman Hero you control that has not activated this Player Turn.
ability_description_3: If Souta is engaged with exactly 1 enemy figure and that figure is Small or Medium, that figure reduces its Attack and Defense Values by 1.
ability_description_4: When Souta successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, that figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

ability_description_1: Range Special. Attack 2 + Special. Choose 3 spaces in a straight line from this Nuckelavee. All figures on those spaces who are in line of sight are affected by Withering Breath Special Attack. Roll 1 additional attack die for each wound on the attacking Nuckelavee. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Affected figures roll attack dice separately.
ability_description_2: The first time a Nuckelavee destroys a figure each turn, you may remove a Wound Marker from that Nuckelavee. Subsume Soul cannot be used on destructible objects.

ability_description_1: At the start of the game, if you have the Oathbound Phalanx in your Army, then you may place any or all Oathbound Legionnaire figures on your Oathbound Phalanx Army Card instead of placing them normally. Instead of attacking with an Oathbound Legionnaire, if you control the Oathbound Phalanx and it is adjacent to that Legionnaire, you may place that Oathbound Legionnaire onto the Oathbound Phalanx's Army Card.
ability_description_2: Oathbound Legionnaires are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_description_3: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Oathbound Legionnaires may double their height.

ability_description_1: Before taking a turn with the Oathbound Phalanx, you may place any Oathbound Legionnaire figures you control from this Army Card onto any empty spaces adjacent to the Oathbound Phalanx. After revealing an Order Marker on the Oathbound Phalanx and taking a turn with it, you may take a turn with any Oathbound Legionnaires you control.
ability_description_2: When the Oathbound Phalanx would receive one or more wounds, you may remove an Oathbound Legionnaire from this Army Card and destroy it. If you do, ignore all wounds the Oathbound Phalanx would have received.
ability_description_3: Range 1. Attack 3. You may attack once for each Oathbound Legionnaire on this Army Card. When attacking a Small or Medium figure with All As One Special Attack, if you roll a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice and is immediately destroyed.

set_wave: Valda's Vow: Seelie Court of the Verdant Pact
ability_description_1: After revealing a numbered Order Marker on Oberon, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with a number of different Unique Dwarf, Elf, or Fey Army Cards you control equal to the number on that Order Marker. Oberon may be one of these. Other figures must be within 8 clear sight spaces of Oberon to be activated.
ability_description_2: After moving and before attacking, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may place 1 friendly Dwarf, Elf, or Fey figure adjacent to Oberon. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may instead choose an enemy figure within 4 clear sight spaces and place it on a same-level space adjacent to Oberon. Figures moved with Welcome, Wanderer never take leaving engagement attacks.

ability_description_1: Obsidian Guards never roll for molten lava damage or lava field damage and they do not have to stop in molten lava spaces.
ability_description_2: When an Obsidian Guard is on a molten lava space it may add 2 to its range.
ability_description_3: An Obsidian Guard on a water space rolls 2 fewer defense dice.

ability_description_1: When this Ogre Pulverizer attacks, it may attack one additional time.
ability_description_2: When attacking with this Ogre Pulverizer, all excess shields rolled by the defending figure count as unblockable hits inflicted by the defending figure on this Ogre Pulverizer.

ability_description_1: When attacking, if your second Zettian Guard attacks the same figure as the first Zettian Guard, add one attack die to the second Zettian Guard's attack.

You may move up to 6 Zombies of Morindan that you control each turn. However, you may attack with only 3 Zombies of Morindan. You may attack with any 3 Zombies of Morindan, even Zombies of Morindan that you did not move this turn.
ability_description_2: Range 1. Attack 6. Three Zombies of Morindan on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Zombies of Morindan in the attack must be engaged to the targeted figure.
ability_description_3: If a Zombie of Morindan that you control destroys an opponent's small or medium figure, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Zombies of Morindan. Newly placed Zombies of Morindan cannot attack this turn. Undead are not affected by Zombies Rise Again.
